fields.label: Meta API Version
fields.description: The Meta API version used by this app. Your administrator manages this setting.

fields.label: Meta API Address
fields.description: The address used to connect to Meta. Keep the default unless your administrator tells you to change it.

fields.label: Allow Sending and File Uploads
fields.description: Allows the app to send messages and upload files to WhatsApp. Turn this on after setup and testing.

fields.label: Receive Incoming Messages and Updates
fields.description: Allows the app to process incoming messages and delivery updates from Meta. The webhook connection must also be configured.

fields.label: Meta App ID
fields.description: The ID of the Meta developer app connected to this WhatsApp account.

fields.label: Meta App Secret
fields.description: A private key from your Meta app settings. Used to check that incoming updates came from Meta. Do not share it.

fields.label: Webhook Verification Token
fields.description: Choose a private value and enter the same value in Meta’s webhook setup. It is used when connecting Meta to this app.

fields.label: Allow Automatic Messages
fields.description: Allows active campaigns, conversation flows and schedules to run. Sending and receiving must also be enabled for the actions they use.
